item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena lights a small diya filled with ghee on her study table. It keeps burning steadily. Her brother then places a glass tumbler upside down over the diya, and after some time the flame goes out. Which statement correctly explains why the diya kept burning at first but later went out?

options.A: At first all three needs—ghee as fuel, oxygen from the air, and heat from lighting—were met; under the tumbler the fuel was finished, so the flame stopped.
options.B: At first all three needs—ghee as fuel, oxygen from the air, and heat above the ghee's ignition temperature—were met; under the tumbler the oxygen ran out, so burning stopped.
options.C: The diya kept burning because ghee alone is enough for combustion; under the tumbler the flame went out only because it could not be seen.
options.D: The diya kept burning because oxygen and fuel were present; heat is needed only to light it once and plays no further role in burning.
